files.title: Official Gazette, Govt of Goa, Series I No. 9, 29 May 2026 — Notification 1/4/2008-II/PHD-Part/1304 dt 21-May-2026: Goa (Rules for admission to the PG Degree Courses of the Goa University at the Goa Medical College) Rules, 2026
files.issuer: Department of Public Health, Govt of Goa (hosted by DTE Goa)

not_published.latest_seen: Goa (Rules for admission to the PG Degree Courses … at the Goa Medical College) Rules, 2026 (Gazette 29 May 2026, notification dt 21-May-2026) rule 8(2), p.5: 'The candidates selected for the Post-Graduate Degree courses in 2025-26 shall pay the fees as under:— (i) Admission fees: ₹ 2,000.00/- (ii) Tuition fees per term: ₹ 64,324.00/- (iii) Library Deposit (refundable): ₹ 2,000.00/- (iv) Hostel Deposit (refundable): ₹ 2,000.00/- Provided that there shall be a 5% increase in tuition fees for every academic year.' Labelled 2025-26 (in the 2026 rules) → not used; 2026-27 amount would need the 5% increase, which is not printed. Terms per year not stated. Own site gmcgoa.edu.in lists PG admissions only up to 2022.
not_published.decision_needed: 2026 rules print a fee labelled '2025-26' plus '5% increase every academic year' — owner to decide whether this counts
